body:
Personally I wouldn't (but then again I move/travel quite a bit) so I know how to find plenty of wild ones. 

In your keep/fortress/castle you have the lookout option at the very top. You can go there and send out a scouthawk to mark points of interest in your area (refreshes every hour). Also another piece of advice I learned recently is to set up outposts to places I frequently visit that are slightly further away from home so when I'm there, I can scout those locations. Then you select the option to turn on the compass, unselect the points that you don't care about (alchemists, demonforges, inns, w/e else) until you're left with just the compass markers for towers. 

These will have varied numbers of floors which you learn more about from this spreadsheet: 

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/1KQrKTDzA\_eEmbMoU7WfyRgA3WrJuoCUmmvD65cCdIg0/htmlview?pli=1#gid=1896770848](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/1KQrKTDzA_eEmbMoU7WfyRgA3WrJuoCUmmvD65cCdIg0/htmlview?pli=1#gid=1896770848)

I personally don't care about timing it (as in what day of the week it is, what's the current utc time, what has the highest level tower) as I'm just happy I found a tower and completed it as quickly/efficiently as I could've. 

Getting back to the point. That's how I hunt for wild towers which are always going to have much more higher floors than my personal ones. My personal ones are staying at 10 floors so I can quickly go through them and get the Titan adornments. The wild ones are the ones that will help earn the towershards and the ascension level materials. I might upgrade my towers to max when I finish unlocking all the celestial classes I want, plus pets, plus max out some celestial weapons. It's literally of very little use (like I said, if you're moving around alot). If not, then go ahead and upgrade. 

Btw the spreadsheet has multiple tabs with various pieces of information that are relevant and worth checking out. I don't know who exactly compiled all this data but it was shared to me recently and I felt it was worth sharing here.
